title: HCERT Specification is authoritative
description: Restates QR Code Generation, Generating a QR Code; Change Log, v1.7.5. QR Code Generation, Generating a QR Code: “Where this page and the HCERT Specification appear to differ, the HCERT Specification is authoritative.”.

statements.label: HCERT Specification is authoritative
statements.requirement: Where the QR Code Generation walkthrough and the HCERT Specification differ, the library SHALL follow the HCERT Specification. Each release SHALL state which HCERT Specification version and which smart-trust IG version it implements (currently 1.1.1 and 1.7.5).

successCriteria.criterion: A reviewer finds that every point where the library follows the HCERT Specification over the QR Code Generation walkthrough is recorded as such in the requirements or beans.
Each release's notes name the HCERT Specification version and the smart-trust IG version it implements.
